text:
lina_cs: Quick note Pilot: Atlas Inc. submitted post-onboard asks. Need product triage so CS can update renewal playbook.

lina_cs: Their condensed list: 1) campaign-level billing split, 2) org-wide embeddings export, 3) nightly on-prem sync, 4) basic admin RBAC.

carter_pm: Which are blocking renewal/go-live?

lina_cs: #1 and #3 are blockers for finance/security; renewal in ~5 weeks. #2 #4 are valuable but not immediate blockers.

jules_prod: Impact bullets: #1 -> invoicing mismatch, revenue hold risk; #3 -> compliance block; #2 -> analyst automation gains; #4 -> reduces support noise.

kiran_eng: Super rough t-shirt: #1 2 devs x 4-6w, #3 3 devs x 6-8w, #2 1 dev x 1-2w, #4 1 dev + designer x 2w.

carter_pm: Priority: 1 > 3 > 2 > 4. Can CS offer a stopgap for #1 so they don't pause renewal?

lina_cs: We offered a daily split CSV export; finance said it's ugly but usable for 4-6 weeks if we commit.

cs-bot: Created RD-4999: "Atlas: campaign billing interim export" assigned to @kiran_eng.

kiran_eng: I'll add an API-first spike in RD-4999 to avoid console work and try to shave ~2w. Will list acceptance criteria.

carter_pm: Please add Impact/Effort to roadmap (billing 9/8, sync 8/9, export 6/2, RBAC 4/3). Lina: ask customer to rank 1-4 and confirm CSV acceptance by EOD.

lina_cs: Pinged customer now. Will post their ranking when they reply. Closing for now.
